# A route that takes `response` gets no status code or redirect from muxt, so
# muxt rejects a template calling the built-in .StatusCode or .Redirect* there.
# A method you wrote on TemplateData is another matter: muxt cannot know what
# it does. When its body reaches .StatusCode or .Redirect* on its receiver,
# directly or through another TemplateData method of yours, generate and check
# warn instead of failing, once per route.
#
# Only a call made on the TemplateData itself counts. .CanEdit does not set
# the status, so it stays silent; so does the same call under {{range}}, where
# dot is an item, and the same template on a route without `response`, where
# muxt does write the status.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
stdout 'warning: GET /missing/\{id\} calls \.ErrorStatusCode, which sets the status through \.StatusCode; on a route that takes response the receiver method must call response\.WriteHeader, or drop response'
stdout 'warning: GET /moved calls \.MovedElsewhere, which sets the status through \.RedirectSeeOther; on a route that takes response the receiver method must call http\.Redirect, or drop response'
! stdout 'GET /list calls'
! stdout 'GET /plain calls'
! stdout 'GET /quiet calls'
exec go vet .

# muxt check prints the same warnings and still passes.
muxt check
stderr 'warning: GET /missing/\{id\} calls \.ErrorStatusCode, which sets the status through \.StatusCode; on a route that takes response the receiver method must call response\.WriteHeader, or drop response'
stderr 'warning: GET /moved calls \.MovedElsewhere'
! stderr 'GET /list calls'
! stderr 'GET /plain calls'
! stderr 'GET /quiet calls'

# The environment variable that silences the response warning silences this.
env MUXT_SILENCE_WARNING_HTTP_RESPONSE_ARGUMENT=true
muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
! stdout 'calls \.'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /missing/{id} Find(ctx, id, response)" -}}
	{{- .ErrorStatusCode -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "GET /moved Moved(ctx, response)" -}}
	{{- .MovedElsewhere -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "GET /list List(ctx, response)" -}}
	{{- range .Result.Items -}}{{- .ErrorStatusCode -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "GET /plain Plain(ctx)" -}}
	{{- .ErrorStatusCode -}}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "GET /quiet Quiet(ctx, response)" -}}
	{{- .CanEdit -}}
{{- end -}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

type Item struct{}

func (Item) ErrorStatusCode() string { return "" }

type Page struct{ Items []Item }

func (T) Find(ctx context.Context, id string, response http.ResponseWriter) string { return id }
func (T) Moved(ctx context.Context, response http.ResponseWriter) string           { return "" }
func (T) List(ctx context.Context, response http.ResponseWriter) Page              { return Page{} }
func (T) Plain(ctx context.Context) string                                         { return "" }
func (T) Quiet(ctx context.Context, response http.ResponseWriter) string           { return "" }
-- template_data.go --
package server

func (data *TemplateData[R, T]) ErrorStatusCode() string {
	data.StatusCode(404)
	return ""
}

func (data *TemplateData[R, T]) MovedElsewhere() string {
	return data.sendAway("/elsewhere")
}

func (data *TemplateData[R, T]) sendAway(url string) string {
	data.RedirectSeeOther(url)
	return ""
}

func (data *TemplateData[R, T]) CanEdit() bool {
	data.Header("X-Checked", "yes")
	return true
}
